c21_implication: No bounded target establishes stable ordering; do not proceed to a C9-based sequential policy without reformulating the decision state.
limitations: quantiles are snapshot quantiles; means, proportions, and associations are whole-trade weighted
ordering_level_distinction: Ordering assesses whether p_t2 ranks value; level assesses whether delay beats immediate liquidation on average. Neither implies the other.

target_definition.endpoint_H: min(t + H, first frozen lifecycle terminal)
